_comment: Static metadata for each game. placeId must be the numeric Roblox place ID from the game's roblox.com/games/<id>/... URL. 'image' is optional — omit it to render the card without a media header.

games.name: Midnight Hours
games.blurb: A survival horror experience where something is hunting you after 1am. Board up windows, manage your phone, and don't get caught.

games.name: ASMR Dominoes
games.blurb: Drag, build, and topple oddly satisfying domino chains. Click-and-drag procedural placement makes huge builds effortless.
